verdict.rationale: Gusto's API docs and CLI show the individual building blocks for an agent-led hire onboarding — employee creation (implied via /employees endpoints and CLI 'gusto employee' command), compensation setup ('gusto compensation'), and employee tax configuration (federal/state tax docs) — plus an agent-friendly CLI with JSON envelopes, dry-run and confirm gates for safe automated writes. However there is no single documented end-to-end 'create employee + compensation + tax' workflow example, and the CLI's write gate requires human confirmation for actual submission, so full autonomous API-driven onboarding isn't demonstrated. Missing for 10: a documented complete API/CLI flow chaining employee, compensation and tax creation in one sequence, and evidence of an agent completing tax setup without human confirmation.
